author: Antonialock
body: This annotation comes from 2 cerevisiae enzymes. It looks like the pathway for b-alanine/panthetonine biosynthesis differs in different fungi. In cerevisiae, spermine is a precursors https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0021925819345144?via%3Dihub#fig7 and in pombe the precursor comes from uracil degradation https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC387649/#abstract1 I will query with SGD if they would remove "pantothenate biosynthetic process" from SPE4 and SPE3, it looks upstream.
